key_fiscal_facts.value_text: A-factor (bid variable) determines maximum quarterly cost recovery: typically 10-30% of gross revenue per quarter under EPSA V (2025). B-factor eliminated under EPSA V. Legacy EPSA IV: cost recovery ~15-20% of gross production.

0% effective rate for IOC under tax-paid EPSA structure — NOC pays 65% Libyan petroleum income tax (Law 7/2010) on contractor's behalf from government's production share; IOC receives contractor share gross
0% — Libya EPSA model carries no separate royalty; government take embedded in B-factor profit oil split and NOC participation

NOC (National Oil Corporation) holds 50%+ equity interest as the state entity managing all upstream; under EPSA model, NOC is the contracting party and retains majority production share (government gets ~66% net under EPSA V including NOC equity + B-factor government share)
